acceptance_criterion.claim: Under matched process and state-calibrated conditions, S1C49 provides interpretable evidence about whether a 20% acrylic-like replacement changes 120 C hold stability without unacceptable temperature-response or realization effects.
acceptance_criterion.criterion: Before physical adjudication, specify replicate count, variance or confidence rule, source-unit-relative viscosity bounds, response-shape and monotonicity bounds, and the minimum effect exceeding matched E2 realization uncertainty. S1C49 may support a performance claim only if its 120 C SI at both 60 and 90 min is no worse than the matched E2 comparator and preferably meets the conservative local comparators SI_60 <= 0.095 and SI_90 <= 0.168, while retaining an acceptable prespecified 80-130 C response and reproducible state calibration.
acceptance_criterion.failure_condition: Fail or remain unresolved if identity or stoichiometry is unverified, process history or state calibration is not reproducible, S1C49 drift exceeds the matched E2 comparator, the apparent viscosity benefit is only a scale shift, the temperature response violates prespecified usability or monotonicity bounds, or the candidate effect does not exceed replicate-based realization uncertainty.
acceptance_criterion.measurement_window: 120 C hold at 15, 60, and 90 min; replicated 80-130 C sweeps; at least one independent realization per formulation and one defined storage or conditioning retest; matched E2 comparator measured in the same controlled process block.

alternatives_considered.relative_reason: Higher-loading acrylic-like point and provisional diagnostic leader, but it is boundary-oriented and its expected effect may be confounded with E2 realization variability and unvalidated state-calibration transfer.
Tests acrylic-like and tackifier-like interaction, but adds interaction uncertainty before the single-modifier acrylic direction is calibrated.
Useful tackifier-only attribution control, but it does not directly test the externally supported acrylic-like stability direction and lacks local evidence for improving hold drift.
Measured reactive-core control, required as a matched comparator, but not sufficient alone to test the external acrylic-like intervention family.

constraints.detail: Prepare S1C49 and an E2 reactive-core comparator in the same controlled process block with matched conditioning, equilibration, measurement order, and hold protocol.
constraints.name: matched_reactive_core_comparator

constraints.detail: Verify AC1920 identity, composition basis, reactive-group content, and recalculate total NCO:OH if the modifier is NCO-reactive.
constraints.name: modifier_identity_and_stoichiometry

constraints.detail: The local state-shift/master-curve rule is supported for the measured reactive-only family but not established for acrylic-modified S1C49; collect a state-specific 120 C anchor for each realization.
constraints.name: state_anchor_and_transferability

constraints.detail: Record mixing history, reaction temperature and time, equilibration, sample age, storage or conditioning, instrument settings, and measurement order.
constraints.name: process_history_control

constraints.detail: Require a matched 120 C hold with absolute viscosity and signed SI at 15, 60, and 90 min; static viscosity alone is insufficient.
constraints.name: thermal_hold_measurement

constraints.detail: Require replicated 80-130 C viscosity sweeps with source units preserved and quantitative source-unit-relative level, slope or shape, monotonicity, and uncertainty rules specified before testing.
constraints.name: temperature_response_measurement

constraints.detail: Use defined independent realizations and at least one specified storage or conditioning retest; decide effects against a prespecified replicate-based uncertainty rule.
constraints.name: replication_and_conditioning_retest

constraints.detail: Interpret results only within 80-130 C and the 15-90 min hold window; do not infer an exact optimum from external anchors.
constraints.name: extrapolation_boundary

selection_rationale: Select S1C49 as an uncertainty probe, not as a predicted optimum. Local experiments establish monotonic viscosity decrease over 80-130 C, formulation-dependent 120 C drift, severe E2 realization spread, and the need to separate viscosity scale from thermal-response shape and hold stability. The rheology-derived rule supports one-point state calibration only within the measured reactive-only chemistry family, so transfer to S1C49 must be tested rather than assumed. Curated PUR literature supports the acrylic-like intervention direction and a broad approximately 20% region, but it is an analogue prior and cannot predict the held-out wet-lab result; the 20% choice is therefore preferred over S1C59 as the less boundary-oriented, cleaner single-modifier probe, not because it is closest to literature. The conservative acceptance thresholds SI_60 <= 0.095 and SI_90 <= 0.168 are reconstructed local E1 comparators and must not be treated as universal or mechanistic facts. The Skeptic's objections are resolved by requiring a matched E2 comparator, verified modifier identity and stoichiometry, prospective state anchors, defined independent realizations, controlled process history, and quantitative source-unit-relative response criteria. The Robustness Adjudicator's fragility finding is resolved by downgrading the action from performance selection to uncertainty probing. The experiment therefore tests whether any apparent acrylic benefit exceeds state, process-history, and realization uncertainty while directly measuring the required thermal-hold response.

evidence_coverage.note: Coverage is adequate for an uncertainty probe but not for an unqualified performance claim. [value-as-reported: local reactive-only hold and state evidence; external acrylic-like region evidence; no local modified-formulation hold evidence]

extrapolation.method: local chemistry audit and curated analogue comparison
extrapolation.note: External evidence supports a formulation region and direction, not an exact property prediction. [value-as-reported: S1C49 lies in an externally supported acrylic-like region but outside the chemistry family for which state calibration was demonstrated]

measurement.method: 120 C hold at 15, 60, and 90 min plus replicated 80-130 C sweep
measurement.note: Local evidence distinguishes hold drift from static temperature response, but modified-formulation measurement uncertainty must be established prospectively.
measurement.unit_or_scale: source viscosity units unknown; SI dimensionless

process_history.method: prospective process-history recording and matched-block comparison
process_history.note: Six process-history fields are missing or uncontrolled in the candidate records.

repeatability.note: The candidate effect must exceed independently measured realization uncertainty; no effect-size uncertainty is assumed. [value-as-reported: E2 sample CV approximately 0.46-0.58 across reported temperature-range realizations]
